context: Ongoing: Capacitive tactile array crosstalk and flex cable routing through the finger. This week: Farah: ground pour missing under the electrode layer, crosstalk from the flex.

Ongoing: Ratcheting risk at peak torque from loose wave generator fit. This week: Rerun to 105 Nm clean; hard limit set at 90 Nm in firmware.
Ongoing: What to show investors when no full humanoid exists. This week: Helena wants a walking leg by late August for the raise.
Ongoing: Drop from 30 cm cracks the shank link at the knee clevis. This week: Zoe: drop test waiting on the machined lift hooks; gantry slots are Tue/Thu only.
